entry_points.text: Strict range free claim, block migrate collect with pressure, and block-wise range migrate forcing unevictable-inclusive stopping on error or target.
Alloc splits smallest larger isolated block isolating once when empty with hooks and prep; free returns only on last put restoring migrate count.
Zonelist eligibility with reclaimable plus free watermark test; zone init derives mobility, bypasses explicit, clears stale skips and seeds cursors.
Manual via all-node control, proactive intensity, per-node sysfs and boot registration with real-time warning wrapper.
Early parsers for allocation checking enablement and order threshold rejecting bad values announcing valid ones.

exports.text: Node suitability refresh and zone fragmentation plus zonelist suitability queries for allocation and reclaim.
Buddy extent removal with watermark bypass for isolate types, and pageblock validation returning start page or null.
Zonelist direct compaction driver skipping ineligible or deferred zones, reporting aggregate outcome favoring success.
Background controls for coalesced wake, thread start and stop, and node attribute add and remove.
Zone cache flush, guard marking below threshold, and reference lifecycle tracing wrappers.

hazards.text: Lockless buddy and compound size may be stale; over-skip accepted while detachment needs under-lock recheck with vector and folio revalidation.
Scans yield and check signals with contents changing between steps; signal or contention forces abort even when page exists; restarts rewind only backward.
Large scans yield periodically; proactive suppressed while reclaim thread runs.
Fast search must not reorder on recently-skipped path assuming removal, else iteration corrupts.

invariants.text: Active build keeps per-block skip marks and shared cursors while nop build treats all suitable; migrate cursor moves forward by mode, free only backward.
Cursor refresh acts only on flush, rescanning from opposite ends and collapsing when none qualify; fast-start keeps minimum pfn consumed one-shot.
Free isolation bypasses compounds into per-order lists with early exit when supply covers demand; strict range validates each window releasing all on failure.
Window uses direct conversion when contiguous else requires valid end with same-zone endpoints; prep derives block rejecting cross-zone with optional census.
Free removal pairs with negative accounting and type moves preserve total; block move relocates buddy runs reclassifying mergeable blocks toward movable.
Pressure compares isolated against half active plus inactive relaxing without filesystem scope; oversize compounds and block-order requests are excluded.
Migrate admits only LRU folios rejecting pinned, out-of-scope file, disallowed unevictable and async dirty unless migratable; success clears LRU, accounts class and queues.
Source filters skip, CMA and mode or type; target needs movable or CMA unless large buddy or ignored; budget decays with minimum; scanners meet when free at or below migrate.
Fast free scans movable lists in preferred then fallback windows; fast migrate skips when hints ignored, resuming or low order, else scans gap rotating lists recording lowest pfn.
Free tries fast then scans downward yielding with doubling stride on empty; migrate scans blocks to free scanner skipping offline and recent failures, aborting on contention.
Extfrag is percent outside suitable blocks; node sums weighted zones; low is one hundred minus aggressiveness, qualifying when nonzero, reclaim idle and score exceeds high.
Whole-block claim when order covers full or half block, reclaimable or unmovable, or grouping disabled; fallback reports first nonempty table type.
Zone succeeds when watermarks met, skipping costly async without permission when low plus gap unmet; explicit trigger bypasses screening forcing continue.
Zone request uses light sync except async with whole-zone at lowest priority; node sweep skips unpopulated; wake ignores order zero coalescing max order and tightest limit.
Mobility derives from masked flags with disable forcing unmovable; compound links head and tails; guard marks below threshold recording order.
Pool report emits header plus per-pool line from stored counts; drain selects processors with cached pages forcing all when requested.

locks.text: Zone tries nonblocking in async then blocking irqsave; fatal signal on release means contention; fast walks hold irqsave; free scan holds only around detachment.
Vector acquisition revalidates owner retrying on change; migrate drops vector before movable-ops or put and releases on abort and end; short folio trylock rechecks mapping.
Node reclaim thread pointer with running state read atomically under node thread lock.
Pool reporting holds dedicated mutex during enumeration; second registry mutex only declared in window.
Drain uses global mutex tried for whole-system but waited for zone, with per-cache spin around sampling and batched release.

state_machines.text: Migrate gates on pressure then skips unsuitable, free and oversize isolating huge only on contiguous path; outcomes abort, skip or isolate with putback and end-only cache update.
Order search walks down wrapping below zero, decrementing stored order on full cycle and ending negative.
Termination orders meeting, proactive, explicit, defrag and direct checks with contention or signal overriding to contended; public maps no-page to continue.
Zone drains once then loops finish test, marking, isolation, migration and forced completion; capture succeeds instantly, exit releases free rewinding restart backward and accounting.
Direct publishes zone to capture, skips excluded and deferred tracking best, resets on success, defers on complete or skipped sync, aborts rest on resched or signal.
Background sleeps or runs demand versus proactive with backoff clearing trigger; demand compacts zones to limit resetting on success else draining and deferring, clearing only when covered.

structs.text: Control holds zone and node, order and masks, mode selectors, cursors with fast-start, totals with free and migrate lists, contention and completion flags.
Zone has start pfn, present counts, contiguity, lock, watermarks, areas, flush flag with cached cursors and node link; node has zone array, thread and total present.
Buddy area tracks total free with per-mobility lists supporting emptiness and tail reorder.
DMA element pairs linkage with device address, page header adds virtual address, pool tracks counts, cached element, device, sizing, node, linkages, lock and label.
Proactiveness twenty on zero to one hundred, extfrag five hundred, unevictable from build, explicit trigger, compact write-only with bounded tunables, pool debug one with tracepoints.
